name: Camp Ruggles
description_short: Camp Ruggles has run a therapeutic summer program for Rhode Island children for more than 50 years. The program focuses on support, confidence and friendship.
special_needs_notes: The camp calls itself a "therapeutic summer experience." This page does not say which needs or conditions it serves.
